Why this creed keeps a person going when every door slams shut.

Kevin Trudeau explains how Ray Kroc kept going into his fifties, listening to positive recordings every morning and night and staying persistent and focused.

He lived by the possibility thinkers creed: go around the mountain, go over it, dig a tunnel, or turn it into a gold mine.

Kevin points out that Ray was 52 when he started McDonald's.

What mountain could you look at differently today?
